pairedWindows.overlap: Collection windows overlap; CPU subwindows are nearby, not identical instants

pressureClassification.historicalAllDStateTasks: UNKNOWN; IO-blocked gauge is not a full historical per-thread D-state inventory

samplingOverhead.interpretation: Conservative self-imposed budget exceeded, not proof sampler caused production pressure. Host process/child CPU accounting is not isolated per thread. No threshold relaxation or restart.

limitations: Only one current paired snapshot; planned cadence not achieved; no periodicity claim.
Critical incident scrape gaps prevent per-process attribution; current values are not incident values.
CFS period-throttled ratio is not CPU time lost and does not establish the initial trigger.
K3s process metric via kubelet is all-in-one PID; component endpoints must not be summed.
Block-device read/write service-time rates are not application filesystem tail latency.
Mac CPU/memory/QEMU facts are current; no equivalent incident-time process telemetry exists.
Historical process-exporter/containerd-specific CPU sources not established; current PID deltas are separate evidence.
